shortDescription: Emergent RimWorld harassment/bondage/control addon for RimJobWorld: abuse-gated conditioning with per-pawn susceptibility, a floating "Command deck" Harem window, weekly pet market, world-incident + notoriety layer (Karma integration), Tales, Ideology + Biotech integration, blackmail photos, a per-tick pawn-index + portrait-cache performance framework, and broad mod compat.
body:
# RimJobWorld - Sexual Harassment C# addon for **RimJobWorld** (hard dep) + **Harmony**. Emergent harassment adapted from AAF Sexual Harassment (F4). Soft deps: SpeakUp, RimTalk, Karma & Reputation, c0ffee Animations, Melee Animation, [NL] Facial Animation, Onahole Extension, Rimpsyche, Modern Bio Tab, Simple Slavery Collars, BondageBed Torture, RJW Quirks/Sexperience/Genes. DLC-aware: Ideology + Biotech layers load only when active (LoadFolders IfModActive). ## Workflow rule (global) Before ANY movement/rename/delete of source files, versioned timestamped backup to `D:\Rimworld\\\`. D: = /d in git-bash. Global rules live in `_dev\GLOBAL_RULES.md`. Key engineering rules: **Frameworks Over Duplicated Code** and **Robust On Error** (try/catch every tick/entry point, kill-switch + fail-open). Finish work with 4 passovers + an honest 1-100% confidence score per fix. ## AUDIT + REMEDIATION STATUS Full report: `Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.md` (+ .pdf, 12pp). Regenerate PDF: `python Docs/_mkpdf.py Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.md Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.html` then Edge `--headless=new --print-to-pdf` (needs Windows paths + a `file:///` URL). ### TRANCHE A - DONE (builds clean, 4 passovers). NOT YET TESTED IN-GAME. Backup `D:\Rimworld\RimJobWorld - Sexual Harassment\20260731-133346\`. - **C1** `SoftDeps.ModActive(packageId)` - ALL soft-dep probes route through it. `GetActiveModWithIdentifier` exact-matches but Steam mods carry `ModMetaData.SteamModPostfix` = `"_steam"`, so 6 of 11 probes were silently false here (FacialAnim, SpeakUp, RimTalk, SimpleSlaveryCollars, BondageBed, Rimpsyche-Sexuality). **Those bridges have effectively never run on this machine - first test is their real smoke test.** - **U10** deleted `Patch_HaremResizeGrip` (postfix on `Verse.Window.WindowOnGUI` = every window, every IMGUI event). `Window_Harem` overrides `WindowOnGUI` instead; coordinates there are SCREEN space (post-`GUI.Window`, outside the group). - **T1** `MapComponent_HarassmentScan.Due(now, interval, phase)` + stable per-map `_mapPhase`. The four 2500-cadence passes no longer stack. **GOTCHA:** the nested onahole `% 600` check MUST also go through `Due(now, 600, 0)` - 600 is a multiple of followTick's 60 and shares `_mapPhase`; a raw `% 600` would never fire. - **C2** `_onaholeBedTypeTried` / `_beOnaholeTypeTried` sentinels (a null Type meant "re-scan every assembly" when the mod is absent). - **T4** `RecomputeHeadGirls` static scratch, cleared on entry **and exit** (exit clear matters - static scratch holding `Pawn` refs pins a dead Game graph). ### TRANCHE B - DONE (builds clean, 4 passovers). NOT YET TESTED IN-GAME. New **`Portraits`** static in `UI/ModernStyle.cs` is now the ONLY thing in the mod that calls `PortraitsCache.Get`. Rules it enforces: - **`Portraits.Sizer`** (struct, held as a field per portrait) - for any portrait whose rect can move. While the rect changes it requests a 32px-snapped size; after 6 stable frames it requests the exact size, so the settled image is pixel-identical. **This is the fix for the resize VRAM leak:** PortraitsCache keys on (size x offset x zoom x rot x flags), and expired RenderTextures go to a pool only ever emptied by `PortraitsCache.Clear()` (load/quit) - so an unquantised resize-derived size stranded ~1.5 MB per pixel of drag, permanently. Used by `Window_Harem._dollSizer`, `Dialog_Stylist._dollSizer`, `Dialog_DressUp._dollSizer` (the latter two are drawn INLINE in the resizeable Command deck, so they had the same leak). - **`Portraits.PortraitBucket`** - fixed headshots snap to a {32,48,64,96,128} ladder via `size*0.9`, collapsing 8 RenderTexture families (and 8 PawnCacheRenderer passes) per pawn to 3. Non-degrading: every bucket supersamples at least as much as before, except 34px which drops 42.5->40 (still a downscale). - Everything draws with **`ScaleMode.ScaleToFit`** so a snapped request letterboxes instead of stretching; when request == rect it is identical to stretch-to-fill. - **Repaint gating:** `Portraits.Head`/`Body`, `DrawBorderIcons` (~94 decorative draws/pass), `DrawStageCorners`. Never gate `ButtonInvisible`/`TextField`/scroll views - they hit-test on every pass. - **Zoom (U2):** `cameraZoom` is part of the cache key, so the `_stageZoom` lerp minted an RT per distinct value. Now quantised to 1/20 **only during the transition**; at the target the exact value passes through (0.82 and 1.70 both survive the inner /50 snap unchanged), so the settled image is pixel-identical. Residual is bounded, not a leak - the pool recycles by (w,h) since the frame size is constant during the animation. - **Culling (U5):** roster column now computes `first`/`last` from `_scroll.y` and draws only visible rows (O(visible) not O(N)); a row never drawn is also never entered into PortraitsCache, so this saves VRAM too. ### DISCOVERED IN TRANCHE B - DEAD UI LAYOUT (not touched, needs a decision) Six top-level draw methods in `Window_Harem.cs` have **zero call sites** - the pre-"Concept 3" layout: `DrawHarem`, `DrawPetList`, `DrawDetailPanel`, `DrawRoster`, `DrawColonyPanel`, `DrawViewToggle` (plus their exclusive helpers `DrawGroup`, `DrawPetCard`, `DrawHaremRow/Header/Summary`, `DrawRosterRow`, `DrawDetailTabs`...). The `_view` field and `ViewNames = {"Pets","Harem"}` are vestiges of that toggle. **Consequence: the Harem-table culling added in Tranche B sits in dead code** (correct if the view is ever revived; the LIVE culling win is the roster column). A naive reachability script claimed ~975 dead lines but has false positives (it misses calls from property bodies - `EnsureFontH`, `DrawGlance` x21, `DrawSchedule` x3 are all live). Needs a careful pass + backup before any deletion - **do not bulk-delete on the script's word.** ### REMAINING - **Tranche C - shared UI framework (~250 ln):** F1 promote GrayButton/GrayToggle/IconButton/MiniHeader/FillBar/Card into ModernStyle (currently duplicated across Window_Harem, Dialog_DressUp, Dialog_Stylist, SexualityPanelDrawer - `Portraits` is the first piece of this, already done). U8 frame-stamp the roster/filter/summary caches (`AllPets()`+`FilterSortPets()` rebuild per IMGUI event: cross-map scan, 5 list allocs, `ToLowerInvariant()` per pawn, `List.Contains` O(n^2)). U6 `FillBar` on `WhiteTex`+`GUI.color` (per-colour 2x2 textures break IMGUI batching). U11 frame-cache the gizmo list. U7 cache border-icon rects. Plus the dead-layout decision above. - **Tranche D - tick hygiene + compat depth:** T2 route the 5 interval scans through the existing `_humanlikes`/`_profiled` index. C3 re-key `FindLockedVictimForKey` statics to int ids (hold a live `CompHoloCryptoStamped` + `Pawn` -> roots a dead Game graph). T3 cap/reorder `MemoryReactionScan`'s `LineOfSight`. F2 TickScheduler. T5 (**data risk**) prune `GameComponent.profiles` - never pruned, deep-Scribed into every save. F3 continue the partial-class split of the 6577-line HarassmentEngine.cs. - **Unexploited ACTIVE integrations:** Vanilla Skills Expanded ExpertiseDefs (Phase E flagship, confirmed installed); **check-first risk pair** `Mlie.Suppression` (overlaps SlaveryHooks.SyncSuppression) + `Mlie.PrisonersDontHaveKeys` (overlaps Holokey inventory logic); then Nudity Matters More, Privacy Please, RimHUD, Grudges!, Rimpsyche-Disposition, Restraints/SimpleRestraintBelt, Epitaph/In Memoriam, VSIE, MorePrecepts/AlphaMemes. Melee Animation is claimed as a soft dep but has NO implementing code. - **Premise correction from the audit:** IMGUI is not the VRAM consumer - `PortraitsCache` RenderTextures are. IMGUI's cost here is draw calls + CPU. UIToolkit is NOT viable in 1.6; `Widgets.DrawAtlas` would be a regression. ## Facial Animation integration (FacialAnimation/Defs/FaceAnims_Harassment.xml) - IfModActive Nals.FacialAnimation - **PERSISTENT (thought-gated):** RJWSH_FA_Nervous/_Afraid/_Hollow/_Devoted. No targetJobs (defaults to ConstantJob = ambient) but gated by `targetThoughtDefs` (+ mood range on _Hollow). Same pattern as FA's own Thought_Naked. - **ONE-SHOT (via FABridge.PlayTemporaryAnimation):** RJWSH_FA_Flinch/_Cry/_Bliss, priority 400. **GOTCHA (fixed):** FaceAnimationDef's ctor defaults targetJobs to ["ConstantJob"], and FA applies any ConstantJob def with NO targetThoughtDefs to EVERY pawn every tick - these were pinning every FA colonist's face. Fix = sentinel `
  • RJWSH_NeverAmbient
    • `. ## Performance framework - **PawnIndex.cs - per-tick pawn index** (on MapComponent_HarassmentScan): `EnsureIndex()` rebuilds at most once per game tick a `Dictionary _byId` + snapshots `_humanlikes` / `_profiled`. `PawnById(id)` O(1). Killed the old O(n^2) upkeep. **Gap (T2, open): the five interval scans still bypass it.** - **PawnLookup** - `OnMap` / `AnyMap` route through each map's index. - **PawnFlagCache** - tick-scoped memo for `WearingControlCollar` / `WearingSlaveryCollar` / `IsInOnaholeBed`. Keyed on pawn ids (never Pawn refs). Self-healing. - **Tick phasing** - `Due(now, interval, phase)` + per-map `_mapPhase`. - **UI/ModernStyle.cs `Portraits`** - the single gate for `PortraitsCache.Get` (see Tranche B). ## Performance settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) **enableDepthSystems** (ON), **enableAmbientBanter** (ON) + **ambientBanterScale** (0.6), **affectionInterval** (3000), **begInterval** (450); 0 disables either interval. ## EXPANSION ROADMAP (phases A-E) A (DONE) #7 notoriety/Karma + #1 Tales. B (DONE) #2 chronicle + #3 owner death/legacy. C (DONE) #4 nemesis + #6 blackmail. D (DONE) #8 Ideology rituals + #5 interactive training. **E (next):** #10 Devoted endgame roles as VSE ExpertiseDefs (Bodyguard=Melee, Handler=Social, Courtesan=Sex-skill w/ Sexperience, hediff fallback without VSE) + #9 Hospitality integration. `vanillaexpanded.skills` confirmed installed and active. ## Target selection & attraction (HarassmentEngine.cs) `TryRunOnMap` weighted-picks a harasser (HarasserWillingness) then `FindTarget` builds a victim pool. **Sex/orientation gate = `IsAttracted(harasser,target)` (public):** absolute opposite-sex override, downed-hostile opportunism ignores orientation, else RJW discrete orientation. `JobDriver_Harass` re-checks `IsAttracted` during the walk (FailOn) AND at arrival. Player-directed grope/force bypasses the re-check. ## Interactive training (Phase D - #5 - Window_TrainingSession.cs) `interactiveTraining` (default ON): Command deck **Discipline** opens a read-the-pet minigame. 3 rounds; hidden state (Defiant/Fearful/Yearning) leaked by a "tell"; owner picks Firm/Gentle/Degrade. Correct match deepens conditioning + lowers subDom; misread piles trauma. ## Ideology rituals (Phase D - #8) Two optional rites gated to the **RJWSH_Ownership meme**: collaring ceremony + devotion parade. PLAYER-initiated, ROLE-LESS gather-party, outcome worker subclasses RitualOutcomeEffectWorker_FromQuality. **UNTESTED IN-GAME - highest-risk surface.** ## Tales / Chronicle / Owner death / Nemesis / Blackmail Tales: `TaleHelper.Record` null-guarded; 6 TaleDefs at milestones. Chronicle: `PawnProfile.chronicle` (cap 100), History tab. Owner death: Harmony Postfix on Pawn.Kill -> OnOwnerDied (grief/hypnosis-shed/heir). Nemesis: escaped/sold pets return as raid leaders (MTB by grudge). Blackmail: photo gizmo -> faction demand; pay/refuse branches; notoriety. Shared helpers: `SpawnAssaultRaid` / `PickRaidFaction`. ## Notoriety x Karma & Reputation (ReputationBridge in Bridges.cs) `AddNotoriety(amt, reason)` = local 0-100 meter + mirror -amt*3 colony infamy. World-incident pacing scales with colony regard. No-ops without Karma. ## Harem window (Window_Harem.cs) - "Command deck" FLOATING Window (Modern Suite, accent-LEFT tabs). Live layout = left roster + center STAGE / MARKET PODIUM + right OPS (Commands, Schedule, context tabs Feed/Graph/History/[Profile]/Social) + COLONY OPS + bulk bar. Owns its resize grip via a `WindowOnGUI` override. Tailor/Stylist/Photos are drawn INLINE (`_opsMode`), not as popups. ~2795 lines, of which a sizeable pre-Concept-3 layout is dead (see above). ## Pet market / Conditioning / Break stages GameComponent.market weekly; BuyMarketPawn -> collar to StrongestOrLeader. Collar SEVERITY grants Masochist/Stockholm (abuse-gated + susceptibility). BreakStage {Defiant,Wavering,Compliant,Devoted,Broken}. Escape/sale/rescue -> RegisterNemesis. **`GameComponent.profiles` still has no pruning path (T5).** ## Settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) masterEnabled, enableSounds, interactiveTraining, showControlTab, showSexualityTab (default OFF), hideKeyHolderGizmos, enableFleeBeating/BeatToDeath, conditioningInstallsQuirks/Gene, **Performance: enableDepthSystems, enableAmbientBanter, ambientBanterScale, affectionInterval, begInterval**, etc. ## Conventions Vanilla sentence case, ASCII hyphen only. Event.current not Input. **UI = Modern Suite.** Harmony PatchAll (astryl.RJWSexualHarassment). Rituals: player-started + role-less + FromQuality subclass ONLY. **Attraction/sex gate = HarassmentEngine.IsAttracted (public).** **Perf: id->Pawn via PawnLookup/PawnById; hot predicates via PawnFlagCache; never re-add a linear AllPawnsSpawned scan for an id lookup.** **FA: any one-shot FaceAnimationDef MUST carry a sentinel targetJobs.** **Soft-dep probes go through `SoftDeps.ModActive`.** **Periodic work goes through `Due(now, interval, phase)` - never a bare `now % N`.** **ALL portraits go through `Portraits.Head`/`Portraits.Body`; never call `PortraitsCache.Get` directly and never hand it an unquantised resize-derived size.** **Never Harmony-patch a global UI method for our own window chrome.** Test companions: astryl.KarmaReputation, astryl.ModernBioTab, rjw.quirks, rjw.sexperience, Vegapnk.rjw.genes, TRIBeagle.simpleslaverycollars, Mlie.BondageBedTorture (+ Ludeon.RimWorld.Ideology).
